title: Capacitance Extraction via Machine Learning with Application to Interconnect Geometry Exploration
problem: Commercial parasitic extraction tools require 25+ minutes per process parameter change, bottlenecking design technology co-optimization (DTCO) workflows.
method: Machine learning-based capacitance extraction trained on standard cell layouts achieving millisecond-scale prediction while maintaining error parity with 2.5D extraction methods.
key_novelty: First ML-based parasitic extraction achieving millisecond-scale prediction for DTCO parameter sensitivity analysis.
contributions: ML-based parasitic capacitance extraction from layout patterns
Millisecond prediction of coupling capacitance under unseen layer thickness
25-minute reduction to seconds for process parameter changes
Competitive error distribution vs state-of-the-art 2.5D extraction
primary_theme: ML-accelerated parasitic extraction for design technology co-optimization
